name: Natural and Cultural Heritage of the Ohrid region
description: Lake Ohrid sits among mountains on the border between North Macedonia and Albania. It is one of Europe's oldest and deepest lakes, home to over 200 species found nowhere else. On its shore, the old town of Ohrid is among Europe's oldest settlements, with Byzantine churches, more than 800 medieval icons, the earliest Slavic monastery and traces of prehistoric pile dwellings in the shallows.
